enemies.name: Kirin Tor Necromancer

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.line: raises two Skeletons for 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Unholy Frenzy
abilities.line: speeds an ally's attacks for 20 seconds, and a magic dispel removes it.

enemies.packs: Three of them are around Atrexis, so kill two before you pull him.
enemies.why: Kill it first, because it keeps raising Skeletons until it dies.

enemies.name: Skeleton
enemies.plain: Necromancers and both sewer bosses raise them two at a time, and they only swing in melee.

enemies.name: Dark Caster

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.line: is a short cast that heals an ally, so interrupt it.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.line: is a 3-second cast that hits one player from up to 40 yards.

enemies.why: Kill it after any Necromancer, because it heals the others.

enemies.name: Mindless Horror

abilities.name: Terrify
abilities.line: makes one player run in fear for 4 seconds, and a magic dispel ends it.

enemies.why: Kill it before the plain melee, because its fear sends a player into the next pack.

enemies.name: Fallen Mage

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.line: is a 3-second cast that slows one player for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.line: slows anyone who hits it in melee, and a magic dispel strips it.

enemies.packs: It pulls with Fallen Warriors, so use a corner.
enemies.why: Kill it before the Fallen Warriors, because it casts from range.

enemies.name: Fallen Warrior

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.line: slows its target's movement by more than half for 10 seconds.

enemies.packs: It is found with Fallen Mages.

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.line: stuns its target for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Sunder Armor
abilities.line: cuts its target's armor, and it stacks five times.

enemies.name: Risen Terror
enemies.plain: The game lists no ability for it.

abilities.name: Fiend Fury
abilities.line: makes it hit harder and slower for 10 seconds.

enemies.name: Atrexis the Grave Knight

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.line: raises two Skeletons for 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Unholy Frenzy
abilities.line: speeds an ally's attacks by three quarters for 20 seconds, and a magic dispel removes it.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.line: takes its target's weapon away for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.line: gives it two extra attacks at once.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.line: is a heavy weapon hit on its target.

enemies.packs: Three Kirin Tor Necromancers are around him, so kill two before the pull.

enemies.name: Lyn the Ignored

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
abilities.line: hits every player within 30 yards with shadow.

abilities.name: Curse of Thorns
abilities.line: is a short cast that makes its target's own attacks hurt them for 3 minutes, and a curse removal ends it.

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.line: raises two Skeletons for 30 seconds.

enemies.packs: He appears when you use your Tome of Dalaran at the rune circle in the north sewer.

enemies.name: Mana Phantom

abilities.name: Mana Burn
abilities.line: is a 3-second cast that burns a caster's mana and hurts them for it, so interrupt it.

enemies.packs: Two of them are beside Arcanic Enigma at the pull.
enemies.why: Kill it first, because its Mana Burn empties your healer.

enemies.name: Phantasm

abilities.name: Reflection Field
abilities.line: turns spells cast at it and at its nearby allies back on the caster.

enemies.why: Kill it next, because your casters' spells bounce back while it lives.

enemies.name: Mana Stalker

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.line: is a 3-second cast that hits one player and slows them for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.line: roots everyone within 10 yards for up to 8 seconds.

enemies.why: Kill it before the melee, because it roots everyone near it and casts from range.

enemies.name: Mana Echo

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.line: is a 3-second cast that arcs from its target to nearby players.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.line: moves it 20 yards forward and frees it from roots.

enemies.why: Kill it before the melee, because its lightning arcs through your group.

abilities.name: Arcane Missiles
abilities.line: is a 6-second channel that hits one player each second.

abilities.name: Arcane Explosion
abilities.line: hits every player near it, and it goes off again when the fiend dies.

enemies.name: Saturated Remnant

abilities.name: Mana Leak
abilities.line: leaves a pool where it dies that restores mana, so casters stand in it.

enemies.packs: It is found with Seeking Remnants, and your shield cannot block its arcane melee.

enemies.name: Seeking Remnant

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.line: gives it two extra attacks at once.

enemies.packs: It is found with Saturated Remnants.

abilities.name: Arcing Smash
abilities.line: hits everyone in a cone in front of it.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.line: gives it two extra attacks at once.

enemies.name: Arcane Echo
enemies.plain: The game lists no ability for it.

enemies.name: Mana Wraith
enemies.plain: The game lists no ability for it.

enemies.name: Arcane Anomaly

abilities.name: Focal Blast
abilities.line: is a 3-second cast, then a beam for 6 seconds that hits anyone it sweeps over, so stay out of its path.

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.line: is a 2-second cast that hits one player from up to 40 yards.

enemies.packs: Small adds wait at the edge of his room, so fight him inside the circle.

enemies.name: Mana Devourer

abilities.name: Debilitate
abilities.line: is a 2-second cast that drains mana from the players it hits.

abilities.name: Drain Vitality
abilities.line: hits its target and keeps burning for 10 seconds, and a magic dispel removes it.

enemies.packs: Any trash left in his area joins the fight, so clear it first.

enemies.name: Fel Ancient

abilities.name: Fel Timbers
abilities.line: sends vines at one player that hit everyone within 5 yards of them, so step away from that spot.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.line: roots nearby players for up to 6 seconds, and a magic dispel frees them.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.line: hits every player near it.

enemies.packs: Suffused Treants stand in front of it behind a barrier.

enemies.name: Suffused Treant
enemies.plain: It stands in front of the Fel Ancient, and the game lists no ability for it.

enemies.name: Unstable Sentinel

abilities.name: Malfunction
abilities.line: is a 2-second wind-up, then arcane blasts around it for 6 seconds, so step away.

abilities.name: Arcing Smash
abilities.line: hits everyone in a cone in front of it.

enemies.packs: Angry Tomes come out of the buildings as you walk up, so kill them first.

enemies.name: Angry Tome
enemies.plain: It comes out of the buildings near the Unstable Sentinel, and the game lists no ability for it.

enemies.name: Arcanic Enigma

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.line: is a short cast that silences players near it for 10 seconds, and a magic dispel ends it.

abilities.name: Manamorph
abilities.line: is a short cast that turns one player into an animal for 8 seconds, and a magic dispel ends it.

abilities.name: Summon Manaling
abilities.line: calls two Arcane Manalings for 30 seconds.

enemies.packs: Two Mana Phantoms are beside it at the pull, and they die first.

enemies.name: Arcane Manaling
enemies.plain: Arcanic Enigma calls them two at a time, and they only swing in melee.

enemies.name: Shade of the Archmage

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.line: is a short cast that hits one player from up to 40 yards.

abilities.name: Bounding Mana
abilities.line: is a 2-second cast that throws a bolt at one player and hits anyone in its path.

abilities.name: Arcane Explosion
abilities.line: hits every player near him.

abilities.name: Mass Polymorph
abilities.line: is a short cast that turns nearby players into animals for 8 seconds, and a magic dispel ends it.

abilities.name: Evocation
abilities.line: is a 6-second channel that refills his mana.

enemies.packs: He resets if he leaves his room.

enemies.name: Archmage Modera
enemies.plain: She opens the portal to the last boss.

groups.name: The sewers
groups.note: Undead fill the sewers, and two bosses wait at the end of them.

groups.name: The streets
groups.note: Arcane spells do nothing to most enemies up here, and your shield blocks little of their melee.

groups.name: The city bosses and their company

needs.name: Bonebinder's Signet
needs.where: Atrexis the Grave Knight, 6 of 13 kills

skullNote: The skulls show the kill order in a pull. More skulls die first, and no skull dies last.
